encode_keypoints_to_heatmaps: create a python module to encode keypoints into Gaussian heatmaps and position indices using AssociativeEmbedding codec
decode_keypoints_from_heatmaps: build a python module to decode keypoint coordinates and scores from a batch of heatmaps and tagging heatmaps
group_keypoints_by_tags: create a function to group keypoint candidates into instance groups using the Munkres algorithm and tag similarity
get_batch_topk: build a python module to get top-k response values, tags, and locations from batch heatmaps and tagging heatmaps
fill_missing_keypoints: create a function to fill missing keypoints in predictions by searching tag-similar locations in heatmaps
